answer: The evidence carries a date, so a proof fired yesterday cannot claim to be a year old. When the panel doubts everything else, Heraldic embroiderer altar cloth proof embroidered onto the embroiderers hall still stands, and its standing is each altar cloth is a needle record witnessed by the inspector. Hand the panel a river it can verify, a hollow it can count, and a gale it can date, and the panel will do the rest.
